_purpose: Per-provider registration playbook + stage ledger for the integration factory. `stage` advances: todo -> applied -> creds_stored -> sandbox_ok -> verified -> live. `owner_next` says who unblocks the next step: agent (automatable now), aidan (human moment - batched into the weekly approval train), vendor (their review queue).

_human_moment_types.portal_signup: Create developer account on vendor portal (email verify; agent can do with integrations mailbox access)
_human_moment_types.2fa: Complete 2FA/SSO on Aidan's identity (eliminated once TOTP seeds are stored for the integrations identity)
_human_moment_types.tos_accept: Accept developer ToS binding ASP EPC1 (one click, batched)
_human_moment_types.questionnaire: Production-access questionnaire review before submit (agent drafts from company_pack, Aidan approves)
_human_moment_types.payment: Attach a payment method if the program requires one
_human_moment_types.vendor_review: Vendor-side human review - not ours to automate, only to track and chase

path_to_live: agent: create Intuit developer account (integrations mailbox), create app, set redirect URI from company_pack template
agent: pull sandbox client_id/secret -> /root/.secrets/meridian-quickbooks.env + Railway env
agent: sandbox OAuth round-trip vs Intuit sandbox company -> factory verify quickbooks
agent drafts + aidan approves: production questionnaire (uses company_pack answers verbatim)
vendor: production key grant, then flip verified=True
providers.notes: Fully self-serve; sandbox needs no review. Highest-certainty 1-click after Lightspeed/Stripe.

path_to_live: agent: Xero account + My Apps 'New app' form (name, company URL, redirect URI)
agent: store creds, sandbox round-trip vs Xero demo company -> factory verify xero
flip verified=True (Xero has no production gate for standard OAuth apps)
providers.notes: Cleanest full-auto candidate: no production review at all. Uncertified apps limited to 25 connected orgs - fine for now, certification later.

path_to_live: agent: register OAuth app in Mailchimp account settings
agent: store creds, round-trip vs our own Mailchimp account -> factory verify mailchimp
flip verified=True
providers.notes: No review gate. Needs a Meridian Mailchimp account to exist.

path_to_live: agent: dev portal signup, demo-env app creation, store demo creds
agent: round-trip vs Gusto demo company -> sandbox_ok
agent drafts + aidan approves: production access application
vendor: approval, then flip verified=True
providers.notes: Demo env is self-serve; production is application-gated.

path_to_live: agent: Uber developer account + app creation (client works immediately for auth flow)
agent drafts + aidan approves: eats.* scope access request
vendor: scope approval (their queue)
agent: round-trip vs test store -> flip verified=True
providers.notes: App creation self-serve; eats scopes are the gate.

path_to_live: agent: SumUp account + OAuth client, store creds, round-trip -> flip verified=True
providers.notes: Self-serve. Low priority (small US share) but a fast win for catalog depth.

path_to_live: agent: PayPal developer account link + Zettle app, PKCE round-trip -> flip verified=True
providers.notes: Rides on PayPal identity - PayPal 2FA is aggressive; store TOTP seed for the integrations identity.

path_to_live: agent drafts partnership email (technical contact, company name, logo PNG, callback URL - their stated checklist) -> Gmail draft
aidan: one click send
vendor: OAuth client issuance
agent: transcribe endpoints from their docs with real client, round-trip, promote from partner tier to registry, flip verified=True
providers.notes: Their checklist is public - the draft can be complete and correct before you ever see it.

path_to_live: agent: prefill integration-partner application from company_pack (draft doc)
aidan: review + submit (binds ASP EPC1 to their API license)
vendor: certification process (longest queue in the set)
agent: build against partner sandbox when granted
providers.notes: Manual-credential path already live for merchants who bring their own Toast creds.

path_to_live: agent: prefill Marketplace interest form (pipeline closed to new partners as of 2026-08 - form queues us)
aidan: approve + submit
vendor: waitlist, chase quarterly
agent drafts partner inquiry -> Gmail draft; aidan sends; vendor review
agent drafts partner inquiry -> Gmail draft; aidan sends; vendor review
agent drafts API-key request to MarketMan support -> Gmail draft; aidan sends
agent: build key-based connector when granted (no OAuth - manual tier)
providers.notes: Per-account API keys from support; stays manual tier.
